meta.name: wait-what
meta.description: Stop. That last message did not land — re-pitch it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把没说清的话重新组织，让对方一次听懂
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常发完消息才发现别人没接住
copy.tagline_en: Rephrase unclear messages so they land at once
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often realize after sending that your point didn't land

howto.what: 当此技能被触发时，Claude 会表示没跟上你最后的消息，并请你重新表述：补充一点上下文，使用 ASD-STE100 简化技术英语，并采用 CONTEXT.md 中的通用语言。
howto.when: 此技能不由 Claude 自动触发。当你的上一条消息没被理解、需要重新表述时，可手动触发。

say.note: 直接触发，Claude 会要求你重新表述。
让 Claude 停下并请你补上下文。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude says it didn't follow your last message and asks you to re-pitch: give some context, use ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, and adopt the ubiquitous language from CONTEXT.md.
howto.when_en: This skill is not auto-triggered by Claude. Use it manually when your last message wasn't understood and needs re-pitching.

say_en.note: Triggers Claude to ask you to re-pitch.

say_en.text: wait-what, say it again in simplified English
say_en.note: Claude will remind you to use ASD-STE100.
Claude will stop and ask for more context.
